verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical. Both leave "soon." orphaned on its own line, push "THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM" into the right edge with no margin, and crowd the logo strip into the purple circle right under the can. They also leave a big empty band between the quote mark and the headline, and the can's "SOLSTICE" label is too small to read. B is slightly better because its logo keeps the original ring-shaped mark at a clearer size, while A's mark looks distorted, like a hexagon.
